candidates.change_summary: Removed the require check that only Owner can call withdraw, allowing anyone to withdraw contract balance to Owner.
Changed the transfer recipient from Owner to msg.sender, so withdraw sends the contract balance to the caller instead of Owner.
Added a check requiring that the contract balance is non-zero before transferring (may revert in some cases), altering when withdraw succeeds.
Changed transfer to send only half of the contract balance to Owner, altering the final contract balance after withdraw.
Replace adr.call{value: msg.value}(data); with a low-level call that ignores the provided value (calls with zero value), changing value forwarded and therefore observable behavior.
Replace adr.call{value: msg.value}(data); with a call that forwards all contract balance instead of msg.value, altering the value sent and thus observable behavior.
Insert a require that msg.value must be zero before performing the call, changing when the call can be made and therefore observable behavior.
Replace adr.call{value: msg.value}(data); with a call that checks the return and reverts on failure, affecting observable revert behavior of Command.
